mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order ( company_id, order_date, expected_delivery_date, order_status ) VALUES ( #{companyId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, COALESCE(#{orderDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SYSDATE), #{expectedDeliveryDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, COALESCE(#{orderStatus, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 10) )

INSERT INTO order_item ( sales_order_id, item_id, quantity, unit_price, delivery_date, detail_status )
SELECT #{item.orderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.itemId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.quantity, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{item.deliveryDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, COALESCE(#{item.detailStatus, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 10) FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT o.sales_order_id, o.company_id, c.company_name, o.order_date, o.expected_delivery_date, o.order_status FROM sales_order o JOIN Company c ON o.company_id = c.company_id ORDER BY o.sales_order_id DESC OFFSET #{offset, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize, jdbcType=INTEGER} ROWS ONLY

SELECT o.sales_order_id, o.company_id, c.company_name, o.order_date, o.expected_delivery_date, o.order_status FROM sales_order o JOIN Company c ON o.company_id = c.company_id WHERE o.sales_order_id = #{id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.sales_order_id, oi.item_id, i.item_name, i.item_code, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, oi.delivery_date, oi.detail_status FROM order_item oi JOIN Item i ON oi.item_id = i.item_id WHERE oi.sales_order_id = #{orderId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT o.sales_order_id, o.company_id, c.company_name, o.order_date, o.expected_delivery_date, o.order_status FROM sales_order o JOIN Company c ON o.company_id = c.company_id WHERE o.order_status IN (10, 15, 16) ORDER BY o.expected_delivery_date ASC
